title: Superhuman/Email
content: Apply Superhuman aesthetic with productivity email feel. Split view with list and preview. Keyboard-centric navigation. Command palette (Cmd+K). Scheduled sending and reminders. Read receipts and tracking. Minimal chrome, maximum content. Quick actions and snippets. Thread collapsing. Contact sidebar. Search with operators.

variants.simple: Create premium email client with keyboard navigation and focused inbox.
variants.detailed: Apply Superhuman aesthetic with productivity email feel. Split view with list and preview. Keyboard-centric navigation. Command palette (Cmd+K). Scheduled sending and reminders. Read receipts and tracking. Minimal chrome, maximum content. Quick actions and snippets. Thread collapsing. Contact sidebar. Search with operators.
variants.advanced: Apply Superhuman aesthetic with premium email patterns. Layout: three-column (folders, list, preview) or two-column with toggle. Background: bg-white with subtle gradients, or dark mode bg-[#1a1a1a]. Email list: sender avatar/initials, subject bold, snippet preview, timestamp, unread indicator. Preview pane: full email thread, collapse older messages, inline images. Compose: modal or inline, To/CC with autocomplete, formatting toolbar, scheduled send. Command palette: Cmd+K opens, quick actions, navigation, search. Keyboard: j/k navigate, e archive, # trash, r reply, shown in onboarding. Thread: conversation view, quoted text collapsed, inline reply box. Snooze: time picker, custom date/time. Reminders: if no reply in X days. Read status: subtle indicator for opened emails. Snippets: /shortcode expansion. Split inbox: important, other, newsletters categories. Search: operators like from:, to:, has:attachment. Contact info: sidebar with social links, recent emails. Undo send: toast with countdown and undo button. Attachments: preview thumbnails, download buttons. Mobile: swipe actions (archive, snooze), pull to refresh. Focus mode: one email at a time workflow.

author: Ersin KOÇ
